en.title: Intention and Saying Bismillah
en.desc: He intends in his heart to remove the state of ritual impurity (the intention is not spoken aloud), and says the name of Allah (Bismillah) when starting.

en.title: Washing the Hands
en.desc: He washes his hands three times.

en.title: Rinsing the Mouth and Nose
en.desc: He rinses his mouth and draws water into his nose, then expels it, doing this three times, combining mouth-rinsing and nasal inhalation.

en.title: Washing the Face
en.desc: He washes his face three times, lengthwise from the hairline down to the bottom of the chin, and widthwise from ear to ear.

en.title: Washing the Arms to the Elbows
en.desc: He washes his arms up to the elbows three times, the right then the left.

en.title: Wiping the Head and Ears
en.desc: He wipes his entire head once, starting from the front of the head to the back of the neck, then returns his hands back, then wipes his ears.

en.title: Washing the Feet to the Ankles
en.desc: He washes his feet up to the ankles three times, the right then the left, running his fingers between the toes.

en.title: The Supplication After Wudu
en.desc: When he finishes his ablution, he says the transmitted (reported) remembrance.

en.title: The Opening Takbir (Takbiratul-Ihram)
en.desc: He faces the qiblah and intends the prayer in his heart, then raises his hands level with his shoulders and says the takbir (Allahu Akbar).

en.title: The Opening Supplication (Du'a al-Istiftah)
en.desc: He places his right hand over his left on his chest, then recites the opening supplication silently.

en.title: Seeking Refuge and the Basmalah
en.desc: He seeks refuge from Satan (Ta'awwudh) and says the Basmalah silently before reciting al-Fatihah.

en.title: Reciting al-Fatihah
en.desc: He recites Surah al-Fatihah, which is a pillar (rukn) in every rak'ah, then recites what is easy from the Qur'an in the first two rak'ahs, and after it says: Ameen.

en.title: Ruku' (Bowing) and Its Glorification
en.desc: He raises his hands, says the takbir, and bows, placing his palms on his knees and straightening his back level, and glorifies Allah three times.

en.title: Rising from Ruku'
en.desc: He raises his head, raising his hands as well, saying the tasmi' (Sami' Allahu liman hamidah), and once he is standing upright, he says the tahmid (Rabbana wa lakal-hamd).

en.title: Sujud (Prostration) and Its Glorification
en.desc: He says the takbir and prostrates on the seven body parts (the forehead and nose, the two palms, the two knees, and the tips of the toes), glorifies Allah three times, and makes abundant supplication.

en.title: Sitting Between the Two Prostrations
en.desc: He rises from prostration saying the takbir, sits in the iftirash position, and supplicates, then prostrates a second time just like the first.

en.title: The Tashahhud
en.desc: After the first two rak'ahs and at the end of the prayer, he sits for the tashahhud, points with his index finger, and recites the tahiyyat.

en.title: The Ibrahimic Blessing (As-Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah)
en.desc: In the final tashahhud, he sends blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, then supplicates with whatever he wishes before the taslim (ending salutation).

en.title: The Taslim (Closing Salutation)
en.desc: He concludes the prayer with the taslim, turning to his right then to his left.
